basic_profile.bio: I'm a college student based in Portland, Oregon, majoring in digital arts. I've recently taken an interest in anime after a friend recommended some shows. When I'm not attending classes or studying, I'm either working part-time at a local retail store or exploring new hobbies like gaming and traveling. I'm in a relationship with a fellow classmate who shares my interest in anime and travel. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school and work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm still new to the anime world, mainly relying on recommendations from friends and online forums. My educational background is in digital arts, giving me a unique perspective on animation styles and storytelling. Outside of this, I have a basic understanding of retail work and travel tips from personal experiences.
